snippet.title: The 7/7 London Bombings: How 4 Ordinary Men Killed 52 People
snippet.description:
On 7 July 2005, four bombs tore through London's transport network in under an hour, killing 52 people. But the most shocking part of this story isn't the attack itself — it's who carried it out: four young men born and raised in Britain. This is the full story of the manhunt that followed, the failed second attack two weeks later, the tragic mistake that cost an innocent man his life, and how a nation was forced to confront a threat growing from within.
